review_notes: I read the whole file. I checked the repo's `TauCeti.socle` (TauCeti/RingTheory/SimpleModule/Socle.lean). It is the supremum of the simple submodules, and Mathlib at this commit has no named socle. The file's new definitions are `zigzagGradedProjectiveSocle`, `zigzagGradedSocleVolume` and `zigzagGradedHeadToSocle`. They are built on existing graded infrastructure (`GradedModuleCat.ofIdeal`, `gradedPositiveMulQuotientLift`, `GradedModuleCat.shiftObj`), so they do not compete with a Mathlib concept. `socle_zigzagProjective_eq_comap` links the graded realisation to the ordinary socle rather than duplicating it. I found no avoidable parallel version of a Mathlib concept. I did not search Mathlib exhaustively for graded-module or socle analogues beyond the `sSup` simples grep.
